title: AET: cross-repo learnings and an AET-B substrate design (no build)
objective: Close #351. Study four sibling agent teams (biztrust, biztrust_ib, bERP, badf-flow-control) read-only, re-measure each load-bearing claim, and write docs/governance/AET_B_SUBSTRATE_DESIGN.md plus one learning. The design covers convergent practice, self-measured failure modes, what is not adopted, components S1-S5 mapped to the AET invariants, a sequencing proposal and the AET-B gate as measured. It grants no authority and opens no rung. Carry the WP-2026-0153 reconcile.
